title: Second pillar of Iman – belief in the angels
intro: “Wa mala’ikatihi” – and I believe in Allah’s angels.

learn.text: O you who have believed, believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Book that He sent down upon His Messenger and the Scripture which He sent down before. And whoever disbelieves in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, and the Last Day has certainly gone far astray.

learn.html: Angels are unseen beings made of light. They always serve and obey Allah (SWT). They do not eat, drink or sleep, and they are neither male nor female.

Allah (SWT) created the angels without sin, only to worship Him. There are very many angels. We know about them only what the Qur’an and the hadiths of Muhammad (SAW) tell us. Angels carry out their duties without ever arguing.

items: Jibril – brought Allah’s revelation to all of Allah’s prophets.
Mika’il – is in charge of nature (rain, wind…).
Israfil – will blow the trumpet (sur) to announce the end of the world and the Day of Judgement.
Munkar and Nakir – question people in the grave.
Kiraman Katibin – stay with each person and write down their good and bad deeds.
Malak al-Mawt (the Angel of Death) – takes the soul from the body at the moment of death.
Ridwan – is in charge of Jannah, its guardian.
Malik – is in charge of Jahannam, its guardian.

learn.html: Angels are not the only unseen beings: Allah also created the jinn and the shayatin. Jinn can be good or bad, believers or disbelievers. Disobedient jinn are called shayatin; their leader is Iblis, the first to refuse to obey Allah. Shayatin bring people bad thoughts and lead them to do bad deeds.

learn.label: ⭐ Remember
learn.en: I seek Allah’s protection from the accursed Shaytan.

questions.q: What is the second pillar of Iman?
options: Wa malaa’ikatihi – belief in the angels
Wa kutubihi – belief in the books
Wa rusulihi – belief in the messengers

questions.q: Which angel brought the revelation to the prophets?
Who writes down our good and bad deeds?
What do we say to ask Allah’s protection from Shaytan?

prompts: ✏️ Write the names of the angels from this lesson in your notebook, with their duties.
